title: Pantex diamond-shaped UFO in 2015

tellings.quote: know, pursue act 2015 uh you know, Pantex facility in Texas where they assemble the nuclear weapons and there's this diamond, you know, shaped UFO and

plain: In 2015 a diamond-shaped UFO is said to have appeared over the Pantex facility in Texas, where nuclear weapons are assembled. Michels mentions it briefly himself, citing records released under what he calls the PURSUE act, as one more case of unknown objects showing up at nuclear sites.
